concept.title: Emergency Stop forewarning and Deceleration Control

conbody.p: If a Hands-Off warning continues the system interprets this as driver unresponsiveness.

When driver unresponsiveness is detected, the system issues a forewarning through a warning message, warning sound, and steering wheel vibration.
Take control of the vehicle immediately.

If the forewarning continues, steering control and deceleration control are activated to help bring the vehicle to a stop within the lane. The system indicates that Emergency Stop is in progress via a warning message, warning sound, flashing hazard warning lights and steering wheel vibration.
Take control of the vehicle immediately. Vehicle is stopping.
Forewarning and Emergency Stop will be canceled in the following situations:

li.p: The driver looks forward and holds the steering wheel to operate the vehicle
Smart Cruise Control is temporarily deactivated or turned off
Lane Following Assist is turned off
During Emergency Stop operation, the Smart Cruise Control vehicle distance is set and displayed at level 4. Once Emergency Stop is canceled, it returns to the previously set value.
This includes the operation of Smart Cruise Control based on navigation and Highway Driving Assist.
